description: Canonical khanary µ library — 36 named micronauts across 7 categories, 6 K-CUBE fold lanes, distillation lanes (java/, semantic/), and the µLeaderBoard for cross-project contribution tracking.

structure.root: 36 canonical µ JSON definitions (tool_call, chat, memory, ui, coder, eliza, khanary, factory, evolution, default, stack_doc, primeos_guide, scx_guide, asx_guide, distillation_guide, fold-µs ×6, ts_coder, programs, compiled_model, native_factory, nnck, quantum, atomic_micronaut, think, ast, tool, reason, expand, librarian, wo, yax)
structure.registry.json: Master registry — name, fold, category, confidence, quant_tier, sampling params, system_ref, capabilities
structure.java/: Java distillation lane — ChatMLGgufAdapter.java, JavaMicronautAgent.java + conversation examples
structure.semantic/: Semantic distillation lane — training examples per µ (_distil.json) + specialized µ definitions

µLeaderBoard.log: .µleaderboard.jsonl (SHA-256 hash-chain, append-only, same pattern as JROM/IDB)
µLeaderBoard.api: MuLeaderBoard.Load(registryPath) → Submit(µId, projectId, success) → GetLeaderboard() → GetTopN(n) → GetFoldBoard(fold)
µLeaderBoard.promote: µ's scoring above the fold-median for 3+ projects graduate to a future micronauts-v1.1.0 snapshot

how_to_contribute.new_µ: Add <name>.json to micronauts/ + entry to registry.json. Submit events via MuLeaderBoard.Submit().
how_to_contribute.distil: Add training examples to micronauts/semantic/ or micronauts/java/ as <name>_distil.json.
how_to_contribute.promote: Any project can call MuLeaderBoard.Submit() — score accumulates across projects in .µleaderboard.jsonl.
